So the path shows a small pre-print drift (+40 by 10:00 = 11% of the intraday move), a bearish knee-jerk to -60 at 10:30 on the +2-loose print, an absorb back to ~flat by 11:30 (ph2 nets zero), and then the whole delivery from 13:00 to a 16:00 close at the day's high. This is the SECOND instance of the post-resolution-covering candidate recorded at n=1 on G21 0618 (onset 11:06, pre-print window zero) and it is explicitly NOT the retracted pre-print generator: I put 11% of the move before 10:30, not 91%.

days.reasoning: GATE FIRST, and it fires 3 of 3 on open-time data - which makes this the day where I have to be most careful not to launder a right net through a wrong mechanism. (a) OVER-EXTENSION: 0629 -4547 and 0630 -5573 session signed flow on 115,618 and 130,053 lots = a -10,120 two-session same-side run straight into the print. The ~$900 cum bar is untestable under the mask, but a run of that size on that volume in a regime whose n0_range_20_mean is 1244 is over-extension on any reading; FIRES. (b) INCOHERENCE: D-1 (0701) session_b_share_two_sided 0.500 with session_signed_flow -73 - a dead-flat aggressor tape - against big_print_b_share_two_sided 0.574 (size-weighted served 0.567) on 94 big prints. flow.big_print_bshare_thin_tape_guard passes it (94 prints = thick, q4 equal-rate bar 0.547, and 0.567 clears it), so the 7.4pp disagreement is real and not a small-sample artifact: size was BUYING under a flat-to-selling crowd. FIRES. (c) PRICED: consensus 81.0 was on the tape from 0626 (days_to_print 6) through the print, pre-print snapshot 81.0, house_disagreement 0.0 - a unanimous, week-stable number that the market sold hard against on 0629 and 0630. FIRES. So the gate says: do NOT emit the full chain-sided band. I comply - and I record that on this day the gate's counter-tilt would have been WRONG on SIGN, because the day's own tape sold coherently: session_signed_flow -2861 with ALL THREE phases negative (-126 / -1612 / -1123), session_b_share_two_sided 0.482 and big_print_b_share_two_sided 0.483 both below 0.50 and now AGREEING (the 0701 absorber is gone). That is a delivered, aligned sell with no round-trip. The 0701 buy-absorption FAILED - covering_absorption_directional_tell branch (b), buy absorbed under a falling price stays DOWN - which is also why I do not read the 0.574 as accumulation. THE PRINT: 87 Bcf actual vs the unanimous 81 = +6 LOOSE, and +39.2 above the 5-yr norm change, jumping the vs-5yr surplus 112.2 -> 151.4 in one week. This is a chain-SIDED (agreeing) bearish print in a live down chain - daytype.storage_thursday_magnitude's delivering case, and magnitude.shoulder_counter_print_damping explicitly does NOT apply (that damps COUNTER prints only; its G16 contrast clause confirms chain-sided prints still deliver a band). SIZE, and why not bigger: the monster part was pre-priced - a consensus of 81 against a ~48 norm means the market already expected a ~33-Bcf-above-normal build, so the 10:30 news is the +6 beat, not the +39. That is the 0116 / G16-0402 'in-chain confirming print is already priced, size DOWN a class' clause. Pushing the other way: the +6 beat a ZERO-dispersion consensus (nobody was positioned for it), the surplus is BUILDING not stable (G16's 0409 discriminator = building surplus delivers the full band), 0702's own volume 84,787 is BELOW 0630/0701 so the tape thinned into the print (partly spent), and the forward burn is bullish (grid_stack US48 est_gas_burn 39.3 -> 42.6 Bcfd, demand 12.96M -> 14.72M MWh; forecast_gw_cdd 17.2 -> 18.9) which caps how far a backward-looking storage number can push it. Net: between G16's coil band (-130) and its trend band (-610), landing at the trend end because the surplus is building and the sell is coherent: -620, about 0.7x the frozen n0_net_sigma_20 of 868 in a regime whose realized activity has expanded well past that frozen vintage.
days.mechanism_window: CLAIM: chain-sided DELIVERY at the print with CONTINUATION into the close - not a spike-and-fade, and not a pre-print move. Evidence, per phase of the day's own tape: ph1 (overnight/pre-open) -126 on 7,819 lots = essentially nothing, which is why the gap is only -30 and why the path holds -60 through 10:00 (10% of the intraday move sits before the print); ph2 (the block containing 10:30) -1612; ph3 (afternoon into the close) -1123, i.e. ~41% of the day's sell flow arrives AFTER the mid block - the day does not exhaust at the print. So the path steps down at 10:30 (-270), extends rather than retraces through 11:30 (-320), grinds through midday and the 14:00-14:30 settle (-480), and closes at/near the low (-590). I deliberately SPREAD the print step across 10:30-11:30 rather than putting it all on the 10:30 tick, because the one intraday decomposition the walk has (G21 0618, onset 11:06) says the onset can lag the print by half an hour and I cannot discriminate that inside a phase-level table. Also load-bearing for the shape: there is NO late pre-holiday short-covering bid into the 3-day weekend - ph3 is the second-heaviest SELL phase of the day, so the pre-holiday squaring runs with the chain, not against it.

cross_cutting_mbo_finding: The two Thursdays in this block are a clean natural experiment on the print-window question, and they answer it the same way in opposite directions: on BOTH days the mid-block phase that contains 10:30 is the largest-volume phase of the day, and on BOTH days the phase that decides the day is a DIFFERENT one. 0625: ph2 nets -12 on 70,526 lots (the print is a pure two-sided wash) and ph3 delivers +1202 - the move is entirely POST-print. 0702: ph2 nets -1612 and ph3 STILL nets -1123 - the print delivers and then keeps delivering, so again the close block carries ~41% of it. In neither case is the pre-print window the generator: ph1 is +766 on 7,419 lots and -126 on 7,819 lots respectively. That is a second and third datapoint consistent with the S108 retraction (G21 0618: pre-print window exactly zero, onset 11:06) and it is now 3 of 3 against the pre-print-generator timing claim on this leg. The DISCRIMINATOR between the two days is not the surprise sign and not the chain - it is whether the print-window phase nets to zero or nets with the chain. A print-window phase that nets ~0 on maximum volume means the information was absorbed and the day's direction is decided AFTER it by whoever is left (0625: covering, up). A print-window phase that nets WITH the chain means the print confirmed and the close block extends it (0702: down). That is checkable at the phase table with no price and it is the thing I would test next.

Reading the day's own stor_surprise as the day's own surprise inverts the 0702 setup completely.
